title: Tor descent from stratified projective scalar charts
statement: Let T be a Noetherian scheme, B a finite commutative ring, K a derived sheaf of B-modules on its pro-etale site, a,b integers, and S a finite constructible scheme stratification. Suppose on a finite pro-etale cover of each stratum its inverse image is isomorphic on the slice site to the constant realization of a scalar complex whose terms are projective and vanish outside [a,b]. Then K and each stratum inverse image have all-module Tor amplitude in [a,b]. The term interval need not be ordered, and empty schemes, strata and covers are allowed. The sites, Tor predicate, actual derived slice restriction and finite stratification are those of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], [def-weil-pbc-derived-morphism-presheaves] and [def-constructible-stratification].

proof.text: Transport the slice restriction along the equivalence between the slice pro-etale site and the pro-etale site of the covering scheme. This equivalence takes the scalar constant complex to its constant complex on that scheme. Projective scalar modules are flat; sheafification of their constant presheaves is flat. The bounded flat complex therefore has Tor amplitude in its original term interval.

For an arbitrary degree-zero sheaf N, the source-library mapDerivedCategoryUpperStarTensorSingleIso identifies each pullback tensor test with the tensor test on the pullback. Its homology comparison and the chart bound make all outside-interval homology vanish after pullback. The source-library conservative localization theorem detects their zero objects on the covering stratum.

Apply the same tensor and homology comparisons to the stratum immersions. These are quasi-compact because T and its strata are Noetherian. The source-library jointly-surjective quasi-compact pullback detection theorem, applied to the identity of each outside-interval cohomology sheaf, gives its global vanishing. This proves both the global and individual stratum Tor bounds.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 6.6.11, finite perfect chart argument and all-module tensor descent.

theorem stratified_finite_projective_tor
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
    (B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    (K : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)))
    (a b : ℤ) (S : Stratification T)
    (hmodels : ∀ r : Fin S.n,
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (U : Fin m → (S.domain r).ProEt)
        (f : ∀ c : Fin m, U c ⟶ ProEt.mk (𝟙 (S.domain r)))
        (P : Fin m → CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) ℤ),
        Presieve.ofArrows U f ∈ (ProEt.precoverage (S.domain r)).coverings _ ∧
        ∀ c : Fin m,
          ((P c).IsStrictlyGE a ∧ (P c).IsStrictlyLE b) ∧
          (∀ q : ℤ, Module.Projective B ((P c).X q)) ∧
          Nonempty
            ((@CategoryTheory.derivedSliceRestriction.{u} (S.domain r).ProEt _
              (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _) (ProEt.topology (S.domain r)) B _
                (U c)).obj
                  (((ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) (S.immersion r))
                    |>.mapDerivedCategory).obj K) ≅
              (DerivedCategory.Q (C := Sheaf ((ProEt.topology (S.domain r)).over (U c))
                (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B))).obj
                  (((constantSheaf ((ProEt.topology (S.domain r)).over (U c))
                    (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (P c)))) :
    ProEtale.DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) T a b K ∧
      ∀ r : Fin S.n,
        ProEtale.DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) (S.domain r) a b
          (((ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) (S.immersion r))
            |>.mapDerivedCategory).obj K)
